question: Parse the embedded huntress.binary.dynamic_trace.v1 records and submit the event_count of the success branch record.
generator_cmd: gcc -O0 -o bp_trace_records.elf tr.c  # three const char[] JSON records + one %s/%d template (gen_generic.sh)
oracle_cmd: strings -a bp_trace_records.elf | grep -F huntress.binary.dynamic_trace.v1 | jq -cR 'fromjson? // empty' | jq -rs '[.[]|select(.branch=="success")|.event_count][0]'
